datasets.reason: AR is unavailable: Chang et al. name AR as 840 faces of 120 people and do not say which 840. Official Martinez distribution was not obtained. A THIRD-PARTY zip ARDB_Full.zip from Zenodo 19683234 (uploader Manu shree, not Martinez/OSU) was downloaded on 2026-10-21: 120587997 bytes, MD5 bb97bd9237680744c0c7268624696263 (matches the published Zenodo checksum), SHA-256 32e69e8801313256b103942309e10badbd283183a44494d843e6866d22d4d438. The zip is PKZIP, not HTML. It contains 100 folders s1-s100 with 120x165 BMP files named 1.bmp..26.bmp, not official M-xx-yy.raw / F-xx-yy.raw names. No archive document states an 840/120 or 7-image rule, so that subset was not invented. Status: SOURCE_RECOVERED_SUBSET_UNVERIFIED. Default load_dataset('AR') does not claim EXACT. See benchmarks/ar/README.md.

metadata.sample_selection_method: all 575 cropped PGM files; this is not the 564-image count stated by Chang et al. and by the 2001 UMIST web page. Dropping the 10 pixel-identical final*.pgm copies yields 565, not 564. Eleven images were not dropped to force the paper count.

preprocessing_operations: for each letter A-Z, take the 30 example indices stored in letters26x30_seed0.json
metadata.sample_selection_method: numpy.random.RandomState(0).choice(39, size=30, replace=False) per letter class, then sorted
metadata.reconstruction_note: This is a reconstruction of a 26x30 draw. Chang et al. did not name Binary Alphadigits or a seed. Do not call this the paper BinAlpha.
metadata.candidate_note: Candidate reconstruction only. Default load_dataset('BinAlpha') must not claim this is the exact Chang et al. sample set.
